verdict.rationale: PostHog's own docs say users can build funnel insights on their captured events and run funnels from MCP clients, so the core funnel capability is first-party. The pack does not document the specific depth the story asks for. missing for 10: documented multi-step funnel construction, funnel filters, breakdowns by property, step-by-step drop-off/conversion visualization, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can build multi-step funnels with filters and breakdowns to find where users drop off

citations.quote: Build trends, funnels, retention, paths, stickiness, and lifecycle insights on the events you already send to PostHog
Run trends, funnels, retention, and SQL queries from any MCP client or AI editor.
